structured-extraction.explanation: Every table was compared with its converted reference and supplied excerpt; all requested fields, missing-value behavior, observations, and non-interpretation boundary are preserved.

text-correction.explanation: Every corrected sentence now matches the converted reference exactly after Unicode normalization.

extraction.explanation: Every extracted city or person-and-age record matches the converted reference and an exact span in the supplied text.

rewriting.explanation: Every output was reviewed against the converted reference for retained request meaning, polite English, absence of invented facts, and directness; wording may differ without changing the obligation.

title-generation.explanation: Every title was reviewed against the supplied sentence and converted reference; each is grammatical, preserves the central event, stays within the requested word limit, and adds no fact.

summarization.explanation: Every one-sentence result was compared with the converted reference; it preserves the decisive event, quantity, contrast, and time information without adding a claim.

factual.explanation: The natural copular definition request reaches source-derived WordNet evidence and includes a definition semantically compatible with the converted reference without treating relevance as proof of another claim.
factual.failureExplanation: The retrieved lexical senses are source-backed, but the response exceeds the case's requested word bound, omits a material part of the converted reference, or provides only a different, overly generic sense; it therefore remains a semantic failure rather than receiving credit for topical relevance.

vocabulary.explanation: The answer is a source-backed synonym or antonym for the intended ordinary lexical sense and stays within the requested short form.
vocabulary.failureExplanation: The source-backed word is related only under another plausible sense of the ambiguous English lemma; it is not equivalent to the intended converted reference and therefore fails qualitative review.

educational-explanation.explanation: The responses retrieve incidental words from the instruction instead of explaining the requested pair of concepts; they are not semantically equivalent to the converted references.
